title: Greek and Latin Roots of Medical and Bioscientific Terminology
description: Course offers students interested in building their vocabulary, especially those going into health and life sciences, an introduction to scientific and technical vocabulary. Principles of derivation of English words from Latin and Greek sources will be emphasized. Vocabulary-building exercises with relevant cultural material, such as Greek and Roman anatomical theory and medical practices in the ancient world, will be included.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GRS 250, CLAS 250.
Assumes no knowledge of Greek and Latin.
